name: Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides, knees above your hips and shins parallel to the floor.
Brace your abs firmly and exhale as you curl your knees toward your chest while rolling your hips and tailbone smoothly off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top with your lower abs contracted tightly.
Unroll your spine and lower your hips slowly back to the floor without letting your feet drop all the way down.
tips: Avoid swinging your legs upward with momentum; focus on peeling your tailbone off the floor using your abs.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed down against the floor throughout the movement.
